rule_description: SCA summary: CIS Microsoft Windows 10 Enterprise Benchmark v4.0.0: Score less than 30% (27)
CIS Microsoft Windows 10 Enterprise Benchmark v4.0.0: Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'.: Status changed from 'not applicable' to failed
Service logon event registered from non standard service account.
Special privileges assigned to new logon.
Powershell script recursively collected files from a filesystem search
Windows command prompt started by an abnormal process
Executable file dropped in folder commonly used by malware
